Chapter 726 - 726 Secret Path; Challenge Again!

Chapter 726 - 726 Secret Path; Challenge Again!

726 Secret Path; Challenge Again!

“Creak!”

The door closed.

Li Ke’s eyes were cold and sharp like arrows.

The man couldn’t help but shiver.

However, he quickly thought of something and shouted ferociously again,”I’m Qin An! Song Shijie’s cousin! Li Ke, if you don’t want your wife and daughter to die with you, let me go immediately!”

Song Shijie’s cousin?

He would let himself, his wife, and his children die a horrible death!?

One had to know…

Back then, Li Ke’s entire family was exterminated by the Song family. Among them, Song Shijie even personally killed Li Ke’s father!

Anger burned in an instant.

Unforgivable!

“Whoosh!”

Li Ke grabbed Qin An’s left hand and twisted it gently.

“Kacha!”

Qin An’s left hand twisted into a strange ball like a fried dough twist.

“Ah!”

Screams like pigs being slaughtered echoed in the private room.

Then, it was his right hand, left leg, and right leg.

Very quickly, Qin An’s entire body was crumpled into a meatball, and blood flowed out.

Finally, Li Ke swung his palm down.

“Bang!”

Qin An was like a ripe watermelon, completely exploding.

Flesh and meat flew everywhere, looking extremely miserable.

At this point, Li Ke walked out of the room.

He held Hu Yufang’s hand and said,”It’s okay.””

“Yes, yes!”

Hu Yufang nodded vigorously, tears flashing in her eyes.

After comforting the mother and daughter for a while, Li Ke took advantage of the darkness and jumped out.

It was night.

The originally bright moon had turned into a scarlet sphere floating in the air, ferocious and terrifying.

A man with sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes suddenly appeared in the luxurious Song family manor.

“Who is it?” Someone shouted.

“Whoosh!”

What responded to him was a sharp sword light.

Blood splattered everywhere as the corpse fell to the ground.

“Enemies!” Someone exclaimed in the distance.

Then, one by one, the Song family members fell to the ground like ears of wheat.

Tonight, Li Ke had covered the entire Song family in scarlet, and corpses were strewn everywhere. It was extremely terrifying!

However, the strange thing was that Li Ke did not see his main enemy, Song Shijie, or the higher-ups of the Song family.

Just as Li Ke was about to leave the Song family with doubts, he accidentally discovered a tunnel under the fake mountain in the Song family’s manor.

After a moment of hesitation, he directly entered.

This tunnel was extremely long, as if it was bottomless.

Just as Li Ke was thinking about whether he should return…

“Whoosh!”

A powerful suction force suddenly pulled him in.

The next moment, Li Ke appeared on an altar.

At this moment, he was not the only one on the altar. Song Shijie and the other higher-ups of the Song Clan were also present.

“Li Ke!” Song Shijie shouted.

When enemies met, their eyes turned red.

Li Ke narrowed his eyes and said coldly,”I’ve finally found you.””

As soon as he finished speaking, he used his palm as a sword and kept waving it.

The tyrannical sword energy danced wantonly.

“Puchi!”

The two higher-ups of the Song Family were cut into pieces like paper.

When another sword energy was about to land on the third person, a man in a long robe shouted,”How dare you!”

He leaped up and shattered the sword intent with a palm strike.

He was actually a cultivator!

Then, Li Ke and he attacked each other, sending out strong gusts of wind.

While they were fighting, the altar emitted rays of light.

“It’s opened!” Song Shijie said.

“Whoosh!”

In the next moment…

Everyone on the altar turned into lightning and disappeared without a trace.

….

Ten years passed in the blink of an eye.

In the past ten years, Lin Fan had obtained five Transcendence Golden Bodies, four Immortal Crystals, and two King Level skills from the system.

Lin Fan’s cultivation state had finally reached King level 2.

“Phew!”

Lin Fan heaved a sigh of relief and muttered,””It’s been more than ten years, and I’ve only broken through one level.”

He only broke through one level after more than ten years?

If others heard this, they would definitely be envious.

King level experts, who didn’t accumulate for tens of thousands of years before they had the hope of breaking through one level?

Lin Fan said,” Breaking through so slowly. Curse Taijun to vent his anger!””

“Kacha!”

One million Spiritual Stones turned into ashes.

“Whoosh!”

At this moment, a loud voice spread throughout the entire Earth.

“Star Lord Lin Fan, please come out and spar!”

When Lin Fan heard the voice, he raised his head and looked up into the void.

He saw…

The person who spoke was wearing a white robe and holding a golden sword. He had an imposing appearance.

He… It was Qin Qiuliang who had challenged Lin Fan before.

Lin Fan realized that Qin Qiuliang had already reached Universe Level 3.

The speed of his improvement could not be considered slow.

However, just this…He also came to challenge him?

Looking over with the Heavenly Eye, Qin Qiuliang’s entire body was covered in countless weaknesses.

Lin Fan had a weird look on his face as he stepped out and arrived in the void.

When Qin Qiuliang saw Lin Fan, he was extremely happy.

“Star Lord Lin, you’re here!”

Then, he said,” Star Lord Lin, ever since I was defeated by you, I participated in the universe competition. Through continuous battles and the rewards I obtained from the competition, my cultivation and battle experience have increased greatly!”

“Right now, my cultivation has already reached the third level of the universe.”

When he said this, a hint of arrogance appeared on his face.

Of course, this was something he was proud of.

“Don’t worry, I’ll try my best to hold back when we fight later. I won’t hurt you.””

When Lin Fan heard this, the weird look on his face grew even more intense.

Universe level 3, going easy on him?

However, he still nodded and said,”Alright.””

Then, Lin Fan pointed.

“Whoosh!”

A terrifying pillar of light that seemed to be able to penetrate the universe swept through an endless and terrifying aura and shot toward Qin Qiuliang rapidly.

Qin Qiuliang’s pupils constricted. He couldn’t even muster the strength to move or escape.

Die!

He was going to die!

“No!” he cried out in horror.

“Tsk!”

With a wave of his hand, the pillar of light stopped just a meter away from Qin Qiuliang.

“Drip!”

Qin Qiuliang could feel the destructive aura contained in the golden pillar of light. Beads of sweat fell from his forehead like raindrops.

He swallowed hard and felt that he was still alive.

After a long while, he said with difficulty,”This…” This… It’s not suitable for us to compete now…”

“Is that so?” Lin Fan chuckled out.

The golden pillar of light shattered like a bubble and disappeared without a trace.

“Since it’s not suitable, I’ll leave first.”

As the sound of his voice faded, Lin Fan vanished into the void.

“Hu hu hu!”

Qin Qiuliang took a few deep breaths. It was as if he had walked through hell and sat in the void dejectedly.

He looked at the blue planet in front of him, and his gaze gradually became determined.

“Star Lord Lin, I will become stronger and challenge you again!”

After saying that, he leaped and flew toward the endless starry sky.
